stem:
Add the following expressions.
(i) $\frac{x}{2}, \frac{x}{5}$
(ii) $\frac{x-2}{2}, \frac{x+10}{9}$
(iii) $\frac{4+x}{4}, \frac{x-1}{7}, \frac{5 x}{2}$

keyPoints: ["Subtraction of algebraic fractions changes the sign of the expression being subtracted, then combines over the LCM: a/b - c/d = (ad-bc)/bd.","When subtracting a whole polynomial from a fraction, write the polynomial as (polynomial)/1 and use the same common-denominator rule."]
